about: Second review of #471 (lab PR 267): a process staged in /tmp connects out with no image on the flow row (the connect raced its exec's image read), then executes /usr/bin/curl in the same pid. NN-L-NET-008's image fallback reads the lineage: in kernel order it is the staged image; on the priority bus the curl exec (P1) is taken ahead of the flow (P3), and judged as of the flow's start the lineage still answers the staged image.

decision.name: Exec from /tmp/
decision.reasoning: Process executed from /tmp/ — common malware staging location

decision.name: /tmp exec followed by network egress
decision.reasoning: Process executed from a staging directory (/tmp, /var/tmp, /dev/shm) then opened an outbound flow (other than a lookup at a configured resolver) within the correlation window — dropper C2 (T1059 → T1571); kill the process tree + posture → COMBAT [also matched: NN-L-NET-008_OutboundFromTmpExec (KillProcess, High)] [judged at the connect, while the flow is open (lab PR 224)]
